name: AI Invoice Processing and PO Reconciliation

parameters.jsCode: const text = $json.text || ''; if (!text.trim()) throw new Error('No PDF text extracted'); return [{json:{extractedText:text,processingId:'INV-'+Date.now()}}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ {model:'gpt-4.1-mini',temperature:0,response_format:{type:'json_object'},messages:[{role:'system',content:'Extract invoice data accurately. Return JSON only. Use null for missing fields.'},{role:'user',content:'Extract invoice_number, vendor_name, vendor_tax_id, invoice_date, due_date, currency, purchase_order_number, subtotal, tax_amount, total_amount, line_items (description, sku, quantity, unit_price, line_total). Invoice text: '+$json.extractedText}]} }}

parameters.jsCode: const raw=$json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content; if(!raw) throw new Error('Missing AI response'); const invoice=JSON.parse(raw); if(!invoice.invoice_number || !invoice.vendor_name || !Number.isFinite(Number(invoice.total_amount))) throw new Error('Required invoice fields missing'); return [{json:{processingId:'INV-'+Date.now(),invoice}}];

const inv=$('Parse Invoice').first().json; const po=$json; const a=inv.invoice; const d=[]; if(!po || !po.vendor_name || !po.total_amount) throw new Error('Invalid PO response'); if(String(a.vendor_name).toLowerCase().trim()!==String(po.vendor_name).toLowerCase().trim()) d.push('VENDOR_MISMATCH'); if(Math.abs(Number(a.total_amount)-Number(po.total_amount))>0.01) d.push('TOTAL_MISMATCH'); if(!Array.isArray(a.line_items)||!Array.isArray(po.line_items)) d.push('LINE_ITEMS_UNVERIFIED'); else for(const l of a.line_items){const p=po.line_items.find(x=>l.sku&&x.sku?String(l.sku)===String(x.sku):String(l.description||'').toLowerCase().trim()===String(x.description||'').toLowerCase().trim()); if(!p){d.push('LINE_NOT_ON_PO');continue;} if(Number(l.quantity)>Number(p.quantity))d.push('QUANTITY_OVER_PO'); if(Math.abs(Number(l.unit_price)-Number(p.unit_price))>0.01)d.push('PRICE_MISMATCH');} return [{json:{processingId:inv.processingId,invoice:a,reconciliation:{status:d.length?'EXCEPTION':'MATCHED',discrepancies:d,approvalRequired:true}}}];

const x=$json; return [{json:{status:x.reconciliation.status,processingId:x.processingId,invoiceNumber:x.invoice.invoice_number,vendor:x.invoice.vendor_name,amount:x.invoice.total_amount,currency:x.invoice.currency,reconciliation:x.reconciliation,message:'Invoice processed. Human approval required before accounting posting.'}}];
